newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: DEALERS SAY MEDIENOS RESULT ON TARGET.
newsitem.headline: DEALERS SAY MEDIENOS RESULT ON TARGET.

text.p: Lithuanian cardboard maker Medienos Plaushas' 1996 net profit of 2.1 million litas was in line with market expectations, dealers said on Friday.
The company said that audited figures showed its net profit was 2.1 million litas in 1996 compared to 5.95 million litas in 1995.
"This is what the market expected," said Arvydas Jacikavicius of brokerage house Suprema.
"It won't have a big impact on its share price," he added.
"It was no surprise," said Saulius Merkys of Vilfima brokerage house.
He added that interest was falling in Medienos because it was a bit overpriced.
Medienos Plaushas is one of Lithuania's leading blue-chip stocks.
